input.answer:
Ontario's rent index (CPI, Rent, Ontario, table 18-10-0004, not seasonally adjusted) rose 2.0% from September 2025 to September 2026.

Calculation: (164.4 − 161.2) / 161.2 = 3.2 / 161.2 = 0.01985, or 1.985%, which rounds to 2.0%. The index is 2002=100 units as published (scalar factor "units"), so the change is the same whether read as points or percent.

Note: the Ontario-level series is used (geography "Ontario", member 14), not Toronto or other Ontario cities. Both endpoints are published values, not suppressed.

answer_values.label: change_pct
answer_values.description: Percent change in Ontario CPI Rent index, Sep 2025 to Sep 2026 (164.4 vs 161.2)
